title: BusductTherMo — Alarm Threshold Configuration (cfg/alarms)
description: Named threshold profiles referenced by joints[].threshold_profile in cfg/joints. Versioned independently from wiring config. Field names and ranges mirror remote_config.validation_rules in busduct_edge_config.yaml; the two must be kept in sync.

config_domain_versions.description: Monotonic version for the alarms domain. Edge rejects a push whose version is <= currently applied version.

profile_id.description: Referenced by joints[].threshold_profile in cfg/joints. Exactly one profile must have profile_id 'default' — used by any joint that doesn't set an explicit threshold_profile.

dt_thresholds_c.description: Delta-T (joint temp minus ambient) thresholds, degC. Range and ordering must match busduct_edge_config.yaml remote_config.validation_rules.dt_thresholds_c.

ror_thresholds_c_hr.description: Rate-of-rise thresholds, degC/hr, computed over ror_time_window_min. Range and ordering must match remote_config.validation_rules.ror_thresholds_c_hr.

ror_time_window_min.description: Sliding window, minutes, over which rate-of-rise is computed for this profile.

persistence_min.description: Minutes a KPI must remain past its threshold before the level is raised. Higher-severity levels must require persistence <= lower-severity levels (trip faster, not slower).

x-edge-validation.description: Cross-field rules the edge MUST enforce beyond JSON Schema. Any failure -> reject entire push atomically, report reason on cmd/../config/ack (same apply_mode: atomic contract as cfg/modbus + cfg/joints).
rules: A1 Uniqueness: profiles[].profile_id values must be unique.
A2 Default required: exactly one profile with profile_id == 'default' must be present.
A5 Ordering: persistence_min.watch >= persistence_min.warning >= persistence_min.critical (more severe levels alarm at least as fast).

A6 Referential integrity (cross-domain): every joints[].threshold_profile in the currently-applied cfg/joints must resolve to a profile_id here; validate against the applied cfg/joints snapshot even when cfg/alarms is pushed on its own.
A7 Version monotonicity: incoming config_domain_versions.alarms must be > currently applied version.

A8 No maintenance gate: unlike cfg/modbus/cfg/joints (R12), remote (cloud-originated) alarm threshold changes are accepted in normal operating mode — thresholds are not wiring reality. Maintenance mode is not required.
A9 On any accepted change: write before/after to audit trail and publish applied version on ack/reported channel, same as R13.
